messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.60
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.60) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

We fixed a bug regarding addint() and addcovarint() for X chr QTL with missing phenotypes.

Karl Broman

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.32
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.32) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

The
 main changes include additional arguments in
create_variant_query_func() and create_gene_query_func(), which allow
additional flexibility but might break working code, and new function
smooth_gmap() for smoothing out a genetic map, particularly to eliminate
 intervals with 0 recombination.

A complete list of changes is at https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/blob/main/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
